'''Seed launchers''' were devices that were used to plant seeds in agriculture. Though they resembled [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], they fired a seed which would quickly sprout into a vine. [[Oggem Baobab]] owned a seed launcher which he gave to his great-nephew [[Mungo Baobab]] shortly before his [[Death/Legends|death]].
